mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the federal funds rate increased by more than 0.25% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% over three months indicates a tightening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings improve due to increased economic activity.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the unemployment rate decreased by more than 0.5% over three months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts by more than 5% over three months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the broader economy benefits from increased construction activity.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of the instances where housing starts increased by more than 5% over three months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% over two months signals increased economic output, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as markets react positively to the increased productivity.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of the instances where industrial production increased by more than 1% over two months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real personal consumption expenditures and a decrease in the unemployment rate over three months signals a strengthening consumer demand and labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increase > 1% and UNRATE decrease > 0.3% in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of the instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index by more than 2% over six months signals inflationary pressure, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten monetary policy.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the consumer price index increased by more than 2% over six months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 over two months signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as increased employment boosts consumer spending.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of the instances where nonfarm payrolls increased by more than 200,000 over two months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real GDP and decrease in the unemployment rate over three months signals a robust economic expansion, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings improve.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increase > 1% and UNRATE decrease > 0.3% in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of the instances where both conditions are met.
